mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte wasting (particularly potassium and magnesium), while methylprednisolone exacerbates hypokalemia and immunosuppression, increasing infection risk and cardiac arrhythmia potential.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially K+ and Mg2+), and cardiac rhythm closely; consider using amphotericin B lipid formulations to reduce nephrotoxicity; supplement electrolytes aggressively and use lowest effective corticosteroid dose.
